tasks.goal: Trajectory: for a flip-and-burn trip at constant proper acceleration, compute position, velocity, arrival UT and aboard time at any UT, matching the boundary rules and reference values in architecture section 2.
In-memory command path: a Universe holding probes, a TravelTo command with a command ID that validates, applies and returns an outcome, and returns the original outcome on a repeated command ID.
Lazy accrual: integer resource stores that settle before every rate change, cap change, spend or transfer, and carry the fractional remainder forward.
Clock service and in-memory event scheduler: monotonic UT from a checkpoint and K; events ordered by (due UT, seq); same-UT chains; overdue events processed in order.
Wire TravelTo to the scheduler: departing schedules one Arrival event at the computed arrival UT; processing it marks the probe arrived at the destination.
